16ms · MCP server

Query the library from your AI tool.

The 16ms MCP server exposes all 2113 interaction teardowns - search, browse, and pull full build prompts - directly inside Cursor, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop. It runs locally over stdio: Node 18+, zero dependencies, one file.

1. Get the code

git clone https://github.com/0xdevesh15/interaction-prompt-library.git

The server is mcp/server.js. It reads the bundled dataset (dist/interactions.json) - nothing to install, no API keys.

2. Connect your tool

Replace /ABS/PATH/TO with where you cloned the repo.

Cursor - add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "interaction-prompt-library": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/ABS/PATH/TO/interaction-prompt-library/mcp/server.js"]
    }
  }
}

Claude Code - one command:

claude mcp add interaction-prompt-library -- node /ABS/PATH/TO/interaction-prompt-library/mcp/server.js

Claude Desktop - add to claude_desktop_config.json (same JSON as Cursor), then restart the app.

3. Tools you get

search_interactions
Full-text search over titles, summaries, mechanics, and prompts. "show me toggle switches", "scroll stack", "glass refraction".
get_interaction_prompt
The full teardown for one interaction: summary, frame-by-frame phases, mechanics (trigger, timing, easing), and the build-ready prompt.
list_interactions
Browse everything, optionally filtered by category (Motion, Product, Web...) or source (inspora, 60fps).

Try it

Ask your tool: "search the interaction library for a pull to refresh animation and give me the build prompt" - it calls the MCP tools and hands you a prompt you can build from.

The dataset ships with the repo, so the server works fully offline. Set IPL_DATA=/path/to/interactions.json to point at another copy.
